question.explanation:
We can calculate $\dfrac{ 4x^4+12x^3+5x^2+16x+7}{x+3}$ using synthetic division.

Carrying out the synthetic division process, we arrive at the following:

$$ \begin{array}{c|rrrr} &x^4 & x^3 & x^2 & x^1 & x^0\\ {\color{red}{-3}}& 4 & 12 & 5 & 16 & 7 \\ &\downarrow & -12 & 0 & -15 & -3 \\ \hline & 4 & 0 & 5 & 1 & {\color{blue}{4}} \end{array} $$

Therefore,

\[ \eqalign{ \dfrac{ 4x^4+12x^3+5x^2+16x+7}{x+3} = 4x^3+5x+1+ \dfrac {4}{x+3}. } \]

question.explanation:
We can calculate $\dfrac{ -x^4-3x^3+4x^2+x+1}{x+4}$ using synthetic division.

Carrying out the synthetic division process, we arrive at the following:

$$ \begin{array}{c|rrrr} &x^4 & x^3 & x^2 & x^1 & x^0\\ {\color{red}{-4}}& -1 & -3 & 4 & 1 & 1\\ &\downarrow & 4 & -4 & 0 & -4 \\ \hline & -1 & 1 & 0 & 1 & {\color{blue}{-3}} \end{array} $$

Therefore,

\[ \eqalign{ \dfrac{ -x^4-3x^3+4x^2+x+1}{x+4} = -x^3+x^2+ 1 - \dfrac {3}{x+4}. } \]

question.explanation:
We can calculate $\dfrac{9x^4 + 12x^3-25}{3x-5}$ using synthetic division.

For synthetic division to work, we need the coefficient of $x$ in the denominator to be equal to $1.$ So first, we factor the denominator:

\begin{align*} \dfrac{9x^4 + 12x^3-25}{3x-5} &= \dfrac{9x^4 + 12x^3-25}{3 \left( x- \frac{5}{3} \right)} \\[5pt] &= \dfrac{1}{3} \cdot \dfrac{9x^4 + 12x^3-25}{\left(x- \frac{5}{3}\right)} \end{align*}

Carrying out the synthetic division process on $\dfrac{9x^4 + 12x^3-25}{\left(x- \frac{5}{3}\right)}$, we arrive at the following:

$$ \begin{array}{c|rrrr} & x^4 & x^3 & x^2 & x^1 & x^0 \\ {\color{red}{\dfrac{5}{3}}} & 9 & 12 & 0 & 0 & -25 \\ &\downarrow & 15 & 45 & 75 & 125 \\ \hline & 9 & 27 & 45 & 75 &{\color{blue}{100}} \end{array} $$

Therefore, we have

\begin{align*} \dfrac{1}{3} \cdot \dfrac{9x^4+12x^3-25}{\left(x- \frac{5}{3}\right)} &= \dfrac{1}{3} \left(9x^3 + 27x^2+45x+75 + \dfrac{100}{\left(x-\frac{5}{3}\right)} \right) \\[5pt] &= 3x^3 +9x^2+ 15x + 25 + \dfrac{100}{3x-5}. \end{align*}

So, our final result is \[ \frac{9x^4+12x^3-25}{3x-5}= 3x^3 +9x^2+ 15x + 25 + \dfrac{100}{3x-5}. \]
